faqs.question: What is FreshFind?
faqs.answer: FreshFind helps residents discover local farmers markets and seasonal produce across Karachi.

faqs.question: Does FreshFind charge any fee to shoppers?
faqs.answer: No, FreshFind is a 100% free community resource to help residents discover fresh local food.

faqs.question: How do I know if a farmers market is open today?
faqs.answer: Each market card displays a real-time 'Open' or 'Closed' status badge based on its schedule.

faqs.question: Where are the markets located?
faqs.answer: Markets are located across Clifton, DHA Phase VIII, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, North Nazimabad, PECHS, Bahadurabad, and Malir.

faqs.question: How does the 'Use My Location' map button work?
faqs.answer: It requests your device's GPS coordinates to display your position and calculate the nearest market distance in kilometers.

faqs.question: What produce categories are available?
faqs.answer: FreshFind covers Fruits, Vegetables, Herbs, Dairy, Eggs, Honey, Baked Goods, and Other artisanal goods.

faqs.question: How do I search for markets or produce?
faqs.answer: Type any keyword into the search bar at the top of the homepage to filter markets, produce, or farmers dynamically.

faqs.question: How does bookmarking work without a backend?
faqs.answer: FreshFind saves your bookmarked markets securely in your browser's LocalStorage.

faqs.question: Will my bookmarks disappear when I close the browser?
faqs.answer: No, LocalStorage persists across visits unless you clear your browser cookies and site storage.

faqs.question: What seasonal produce is available in summer?
faqs.answer: Summer brings juicy tomatoes, sweet corn, blueberries, yellow peaches, and fresh basil.

faqs.question: What produce is available in winter?
faqs.answer: Winter highlights include fresh spinach, sweet Valencia oranges, butternut squash, and farmhouse butter.

faqs.question: Can I bring my pet to outdoor markets?
faqs.answer: Well-behaved dogs on short leashes are welcomed in outdoor market walkways.

faqs.question: What payment methods do vendors take?
faqs.answer: Most vendors take cash and debit/credit cards. Many also support mobile bank app transfers.

faqs.question: How can local growers join as market vendors?
faqs.answer: Reach out via our Contact form or email hello@freshfind.com with your farm and crop details.

faqs.question: How often is the market data updated?
faqs.answer: Operating hours, seasonal crops, and vendor availability are reviewed bi-weekly.

faqs.question: How does the FreshFind chatbot work?
faqs.answer: The chatbot uses a client-side JSON knowledge base to instantly match keywords and answer common inquiries.
